# Robin Gerth

> Full-stack developer (Angular, Django REST Framework, Shopware 6, REST APIs). Also offers AI feasibility workshops, AI-assisted automation, Shopware consulting and SEO/GEO audits for small and medium-sized businesses. Site available in English and German (language toggle in the header, no separate URLs yet).

## Role & focus
- Full-stack developer with hands-on experience in productive business systems: Shopware 6, backend logic, REST APIs, Angular frontends, selected Kotlin adjustments for Android.
- Works in a structured way: clear requirements, traceable decisions, maintainable delivery.
- Uses AI-assisted development tools for research, code analysis and refactoring; engineering judgement and technical control stay with the developer.

## Consulting & automation offers
- **AI feasibility workshops** – structured workshops for SMEs to clarify where AI/automation projects are realistic and what effort they involve.
- **AI-assisted automation** – implementation of automations such as n8n-based RAG chatbots and workflow automation for recurring tasks.
- **Shopware consulting** – conversion optimization and technical development for Shopware 6 operators.
- **SEO/GEO audits** – Search Engine + Generative Engine Optimization audits for online shops and SMEs, with prioritized optimization potential.

## Tech stack
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Angular, TypeScript, Shopware 6, PHP, Symfony, Kotlin, REST APIs, Linux, Git.

## Case studies
- ABC Design – Shopware 6 / PHP / Symfony / REST APIs / Kotlin Android app work on a productive e-commerce system.
- Join – Kanban task tool (JavaScript, Firebase).
- DaBubble – Messenger application (Angular, TypeScript, Firebase).
- Videoflix – Full-stack streaming platform (Python, Django REST Framework, Angular).
- El Pollo Loco – Browser game (JavaScript, Canvas, OOP).
